protocol.purpose: Actual stochastic Three.js SSRNode convergence against an independent converged SSR reference; not physically unbiased path tracing ground truth.
protocol.manualFrameLifecycle: Explicitly advance renderer._nodes.nodeFrame before each manual RenderPipeline.render(), then assert SSRNode advanced its noise index exactly to the requested frame. FRAME-scoped SSR and scene passes must run for every counted sample.
protocol.scene: Three adjacent metallic floor strips with roughness 0.12, 0.3 and 0.65; three emissive-color boxes; fixed perspective camera and static geometry.
protocol.dimensions: Four independently generated scalar volumes, seeds 1 through 4, used for Xi.x, Xi.y, ray-march jitter and Xi.w respectively. All values quantized to 8-bit bin centers. Same addressing and 32-frame cycle shift (37,71).

phaseExtension.reason: Initial phase-zero SSR findings prompted broader starting-window coverage, without tuning the sampler or scene.
phaseExtension.reference: Reuse the original independent 4096-sample SSR reference
phaseExtension.aggregation: Mean square error over all 32 phases before square root, plus each phase separately and min/max; preserve original 24 phase-zero metrics.

reference.generator: Three.js PCG integer hash with independent frame, pixel and dimension keys; no candidate masks

protocol.throughput: Actual scene rendering at 128x128, no GPU readback; each FAST/GSA measurement has at least one second warmup followed by at least three measured seconds, 16-frame GPU-completed batches, drained queues before switching, both method orders. Vsync and frame caps disabled. Not a claim of interactive high-resolution FPS.
protocol.metrics: RGB RMSE of temporally averaged SSR output, all pixels and fixed lower-half image ROI (WebGPU rows 64 through 127, foreground floor), raw and identical 3x3 binomial filtered candidate and reference. Report reference half-to-full RMSE separately.
protocol.limitations: Static scene only; no environment MIS, recurrent denoiser or production motion integration. Four seed dimensions form one evaluated sampler instance, not independent confidence trials.

renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x00001638) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-31.0.12027.9001)
